Aegis is a hidden operating system that runs on your phone. Apps installed inside Aegis live in an isolated sandbox: separate storage, virtual contacts and identity, and a private encrypted vault for photos and videos taken in Aegis. No root required.
QQ Group (Click to copy group number)

In Meizu OS phones, you can only add an app to Aegis by cloning an existing app that\'s already installed (you cannot install an app in Aegis via sideloading an apk). You must also install XposedInstaller manually, as, unlike installations on other Android phones, it isn\'t built in to Aegis when installing on Meizu OS. Please install XposedInstaller first.
The maintaining of Aegis costs lots of my time, if you appreciate my work, buy me a cup of coffee! :)
Installation may take a while, please be patient… :)
If you do not like my new icon, you are always welcome to design a new icon for Aegis ;)

Aegis is built on the VirtualApp engine (by asLody) and the VirtualXposed fork (by weishu/tiann), with hidden-API compatibility powered by LSPosed\u2019s HiddenApiBypass. Endless respect to the FOSS engineers whose work made this possible.

A long time ago, I revealed the information about EXposed. After a period of feedback and adjustment, EXposed has reached a milestone. Many users may don't know it, let me introduce you today. 


Like the Aegis I created earlier, EXposed is also an app that makes you use Xposed module without root, unlock the bootloader. they both have their own advantages, and EXposed will be much better in terms of performance and stability due to running directly in the native system; while Aegis is based on VitualApp, which is like Parallel Space. EXposed was born a month, and its stability has surpassed Aegis which has been developed for nearly a year. 


Currently, EXposed has been put on the app store and renamed to Tai Chi. You can try it out :)

Apps inside Aegis run in a sealed container. Photos and videos in the vault are encrypted with AES-256-GCM; keys live in the hardware keystore when available.
